products.title: ReWind™ CNC Machined Titanium Bolt-Action Studio Pen
products.summary: Precision-turned Grade 5 titanium bolt-action drafting pen featuring micro-grooved tactile grip rings, a smooth C-shaped bolt channel, and a milled stainless pocket clip.
highlights: Fluid C-Channel Bolt Action: One-piece machined internal carrier glides along a curved J/C-slot with a crisp mechanical lock and zero spring rattle.
Micro-Grooved Non-Slip Barrel: Concentric lathe-turned micro-ridges along the entire barrel provide effortless grip during long sketching and note-taking sessions.
Deep-Carry Milled Stainless Clip: Secured with dual flush-mounted Torx screws for reliable pocket and notebook carry.
Universal Rollerball & Gel Refill Fit: Ships pre-loaded with a smooth 0.5mm black archival gel ink cartridge (compatible with Pilot G2 & Parker-style refills).

specs.Mechanism: Curved Bolt-Action with Solid Titanium Thumb Stud

products.title: ReWind™ GlideMat Pro — Micro-Weave Precision Desk Pad (900×400mm)
products.summary: Large-format 900×400×4mm studio and gaming desk mat engineered with high-density micro-textured jacquard cloth, sub-surface flat-lock stitching, and a 4mm natural rubber base.
highlights: Calibrated X/Y Optical Tracking: High-density micro-weave surface delivers effortless glide for PTFE and magnesium mouse skates with pinpoint stopping power.
Recessed Sub-Surface Edge Stitching: Ultra-narrow flat-lock perimeter stitch sits flush with the pad surface to eliminate wrist irritation.
Spill-Repellent Nano Coating: Liquids bead up on contact and wipe clean without staining or altering surface glide.
4mm Dense Natural Rubber Core: Eliminates desk surface imperfections and dampens mechanical keyboard acoustics.
